title: 3867. Sum of GCD of Formed Pairs

examples.explanation: Construct prefixGcd: i nums[i] mxi prefixGcd[i] 0 2 2 2 1 6 6 6 2 4 6 2 prefixGcd = [2, 6, 2]. After sorting, it forms [2, 2, 6]. Pair the smallest and largest elements: gcd(2, 6) = 2. The remaining middle element 2 is ignored. Thus, the sum is 2.

Construct prefixGcd: i nums[i] mxi prefixGcd[i] 0 3 3 3 1 6 6 6 2 2 6 2 3 8 8 8 prefixGcd = [3, 6, 2, 8]. After sorting, it forms [2, 3, 6, 8]. Form pairs: gcd(2, 8) = 2 and gcd(3, 6) = 3. Thus, the sum is 2 + 3 = 5.
